instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: Copy GY GB name/Level; tag out. If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a Gladiator Beast monster: You can send 1 Gladiator Beast monster from your Deck or Extra Deck to the GY, except Gladiator Beast Attorix; until the End Phase, this card's Level and name become the same as that monster sent to the GY. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 Gladiator Beast monster from your Deck, except Gladiator Beast Attorix.

If Summoned this way, banish this card when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of Destiny HERO - Dreamer once per turn.

Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. If this card is Special Summoned, or a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY while this card is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of it.
